name: preview
title: Preview
purpose: Render Vue content in an isolated responsive, preset, or exact logical viewport with bounded or content-preserving height.
avoidFor: Content that depends on the parent document DOM
accessibility: The isolated frame has a required title.
Natural-height previews disable iframe scrolling, forward wheel or touch input to the nearest marked or scrollable owner, and emit the delta for observation.
The fullscreen trigger uses a near-opaque semantic background/foreground pair, thin boundary, and elevation so it remains distinguishable over arbitrary preview content.
Fullscreen is a labelled chromeless dialog with one close action.
Palette and theme state synchronize into the frame document.
commonMistakes: Treating CSS transform scale as logical viewport width without iframe isolation.
Nesting an additional iframe scrollbar around an autoHeight preview.
Placing essential controls only in fullscreen.
